title: Industrial screw driving dataset collection: Time series data for process monitoring and anomaly detection

equation_quality.supported_scope: See exact linked equations and parameter states; successful replay is not mechanism identification.

independent_units.independent_unit_description: workpiece (both locations and every reuse cycle)

calibration_burden: Early and completed Finding-phase features; prior completed same-hole cycles are permitted. No current late-window target calibration.

baseline_strength.scope: Matched task/input access; historical controls are not claimed to exhaust state of the art.

practical_relevance.prediction_time: Current measurements stop at the frozen first-forward-crossing prefix (first sampled angle at/above 250 degrees); prior responses only from completed same-hole operations. Both holes and every reuse of a workpiece stay together.
practical_relevance.claim_blockers: Transfer is restricted to the declared source and cohort; no measured deployment intervention.

promotion_conditions: Reassess only under a versioned contract; never rename exposed outcomes as fresh.

practical_use_contract.intended_user: Domain researcher or process analyst; operational adoption not demonstrated
practical_use_contract.inputs_available_when: Current measurements stop at the frozen first-forward-crossing prefix (first sampled angle at/above 250 degrees); prior responses only from completed same-hole operations. Both holes and every reuse of a workpiece stay together.
practical_use_contract.calibration_requirement: Early and completed Finding-phase features; prior completed same-hole cycles are permitted. No current late-window target calibration.
practical_use_contract.calibration_cost: Not monetized or timed in the corpus; no zero-cost assumption
